title: Performance Ops Briefing — Token Chorus & Latency Lattice Prototype
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Prototype a compact briefing panel for SREs and platform product owners that combines a 'latency lattice' (small-multiple latency quantiles per route + model) with a 'token chorus' (token-density heat matrix and token-cost harmonics). Goal is a scannable page for root-cause triage and rollout decisions. Includes mobile/compact layout and an expandable deep-dive pane for microtraces and request samples.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma screens for desktop + compact (3 breakpoints) with annotated component specs
Chart spec doc that describes data schema, aggregation windows, quantiles, and thresholds for alerts
Interactive prototype demonstrating expand/collapse of route rows and token-density brushing
Hand-off package with CSS tokens, accessibility contrast checks, and export-ready assets
Design sign-off from PM (R. Patel) and Eng (M. Ortiz) or a list of required follow-ups
review_comments: PM: prefer default sort by 'cost impact' rather than latency percentile; include a toggle (R. Patel, 2026-03-03)
Eng: ensure the token-density brush maps directly to request-sample query (M. Ortiz, 2026-03-04) — flagged a backend dependency
Security: verify that request samples in deep-dive strip PII by default (J. Kaur, 2026-03-05)
Design: reduce visual noise by collapsing tiny-sparkline labels into hover tooltips (A. Martinez, 2026-03-06)
Accessibility: colorblind-safe palette applied; need contrast test for low-light mode (Accessibility team, 2026-03-08)
design_notes: Latency Lattice: 4 x small-multiple grid — p50, p75, p95, p99. Each cell shows median line + shaded IQR + outlier ticks.
Token Chorus: route × model matrix where cell intensity = tokens per request density; hover shows token distribution histogram and top prompt examples (sampled, redacted).
Cost Harmonies: optional overlay lines showing per-token $ estimate normalized by model family; used for quick trade-off sorting.
Interaction: row fold/unfold reveals microtrace swimmer and request sample panel anchored to the right. Brushing on token histogram filters microtraces.
Performance: all visuals optimized for 100-200 routes on a single page via lightweight canvas layers and progressive rendering for older browsers.
tradeoffs: Showing samples inline increases cognitive load but speeds triage — compromise: samples behind a 1-click reveal with redaction by default.
High-frequency updates (1s) are desirable for SREs but will increase cost — propose 15s default with a 5s 'live mode' toggle for on-call.
Token-density grid provides compact overview but can obscure per-route variance — added microtrace fold for variance inspection.
decisions: Default panel sorting: cost impact desc (PM request) with toggle to latency p95 desc — recorded 2026-03-04
Use heatmap color palette 'Orchid-Teal' (colorblind-safe) for token density — approved 2026-03-05
Samples redaction pipeline: redact email/SSNs at render time; Eng to add server-side filter where possible — blocker until infra change completed
